article.title: ‘Os sentidos do trabalho: Ensaio sobre a afirmação e a negação do trabalho’ by Ricardo Antunes
article.author: Editor
article.content: In 1999, the first edition of the Brazilian sociologist Ricardo Antunes’s The Meanings of Work [Os sentidos do trabalho] was published. Its stakes were clear: against the idea that new communication and automation technologies were announcing the “end of work”, Antunes insisted that work remained vital, both for capital and for humanity. The post ‘Os sentidos do trabalho: Ensaio sobre a afirmação e a negação do trabalho’ by Ricardo Antunes appeared first on MR Online .
